articles.title: Push-based KV transfer to improve TTFT and TPOT for disaggregated inference in vLLM
articles.excerpt: vLLM's prefill-decode disaggregation splits LLM inference across engine instances but must transfer the KV cache between them. This post introduces a push-based NIXL connector that moves transfer coordination off the critical path, delivering up to 3x better TTFT and 30% better TPOT in benchmarks on Amazon EC2 P5en instances with AWS EFA.

image.alt: Pull-mode timeline: router relay, decode-side allocation, and NIXL READ run serially on the path to first token.

fa.title: انتقال KV مبتنی بر فشار برای بهبود TTFT و TPOT برای عدم توافق در vLLM
fa.excerpt: نقض پیش آگهی vLLM، LLM را در مورد موارد موتور تقسیم می کند، اما باید کش KV را بین آنها انتقال دهد. این پست یک اتصال NIXL مبتنی بر فشار را معرفی می کند که هماهنگی انتقال را از مسیر بحرانی حرکت می دهد و تا 3x بهتر TTFT و 30٪ بهتر TPOT در معیارهای Amazon EC2 P5en با EFA ارائه می دهد.

articles.title: Improve TTFT for multi-turn agentic workloads with bi-directional KV transfer in vLLM
articles.excerpt: Multi-turn agentic workloads reprocess growing conversation context each turn, driving up latency. See how bi-directional KV cache transfer lets prefill and decode nodes reuse previously computed context across turns, cutting time to first token by up to 1.6x for Qwen3-32B and 3.3x for GLM-5-FP8 on Amazon EC2 P5en instances with EFA.

image.alt: Flow diagram contrasting the standard prefill-to-decode KV path (blue) with the bi-directional additions numbered one through six (red)

fa.title: بهبود TTFT برای کار چند منظوره با انتقال دو طرفه KV در vLLM

articles.title: AI researchers stranded Claude on a virtual desert island. It started to “play.”
articles.excerpt: What do AI agents do if you don’t tell them to do anything? The answer looks a lot like play. Researchers repeatedly stranded them alone on a virtual desert island for 30 hours in an experiment reminiscent of the movies Cast Away or Home Alone. articles.title: Disney Asked Character.AI to Go Bankrupt for a Get-Out-of-Lawsuits Card
articles.excerpt: The entertainment giant hopes to get trust and safety tech, among other IP, from a startup whose chatbots dozens of states allege encouraged minors to self-harm and kill their parents.
